verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a real-time communications platform, so the axis applies. The only self-hosting evidence covers a single component, self-hosted recording, which is adjacent rather than the core product. Nothing shows the core real-time voice, video and messaging network, or the agent platform, can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosted recording for control and compliance needs.
